title: Odd Fourier coefficients bounded by their maximum
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$. For every subset $S$ of the coordinates with odd cardinality, the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ is at most the maximum of $0$ and all Fourier coefficients at odd-cardinality subsets of the coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
$S$ is a subset of the coordinates
